On 2023/05/21 the user asked about the challenges Houston faces in providing adequate public education for all students. #houston_education #public_education

Houston public education challenges discussed: property-tax-reliant state school finance causing inconsistent funding, one of the largest achievement gaps in the country, over one-third of students being English language learners, and a teacher shortage in subjects like science and math. #houston_education

Efforts addressing Houston education challenges: Texas school finance reform (2019 bill added $6.5 billion), community partnerships to close the achievement gap, HISD bilingual/dual-language immersion programs, and alternative teacher certification programs. #houston_education

Measurable impacts reported for Houston education efforts: 2019 Texas finance reform added $6.5B; small decreases in white-Hispanic and white-Black achievement gaps in 2018-2019; HISD had a 94% ELL graduation rate in 2018 vs 67% statewide; HISD hired over 2,000 teachers via alternative certification in 2018-2019. #houston_education

Innovative Houston education programs discussed: EMERGE (college-readiness, founded 2009, 1,300+ students to selective colleges), Early Matters (early childhood coalition; 2018 ballot initiative funded free full-day pre-K in HISD), Energized For STEM Academy charter network (2019 National Blue Ribbon School), and Houston A+ Challenge (teacher/school innovation grants). #houston_education

Test report "P&T + Lube" 40_21 covers the 755 Front Agri Axle p/n 10145957 (Proto 0, M2 21V CVT, 1 sample), run at Dana Off Highway Arco (Italy) April 7-8 2021, completion June 7 2021, engineer D. Zaglia. It tested a reduced oil level of -0.5 L with Total Tractelf SF3 (ELF SF3) oil; result: Partially PASSED. #dana #axle-test #755axle

Key results, 755/10145957 M2 21V CVT P&T + Lube test: power loss 3.60 kW @90°C (ref 4.55), 4.2 kW @60°C (ref 5.7), 8.1 kW @25°C ambient (ref 10.3); REV power loss lower than FWD. P&T at 3234 rpm FWD: 85°C / 2.8 kW at 1h06, then power-loss step-up with no stabilization; ~110°C / 5.3 kW at 2 h; max allowable oil temp 120°C. #dana #axle-test #755axle

755/10145957 axle test conclusions: lubrication OK (oil level always above minimum in all compartments, no leaks), but P&T curves irregular after 1h06 due to power-loss step-up; recommendation was not to reduce oil further until the step-up is solved. Final tear-down done after the subsequent 97_20 hi-speed test; pinion tail bearing cup OK, back-head bearing cup showed dragged hard-particle marks. #dana #axle-test #755axle

On 2023/05/28 the user asked about George Washington's ownership of enslaved people, why he didn't free them all, who was not freed, and when Martha Washington's inherited slaves were fully freed. #george-washington #slavery-history

George Washington's will (1799) freed 123 enslaved people he owned outright, with emancipation to take effect after Martha's death; the enslaved people he held through the Custis estate (dower slaves) could not legally be freed by him. #george-washington #slavery-history

Correction to an earlier answer about Washington's will: it did not free enslaved people who had served 30+ years or were over 60. It directed that elderly and infirm enslaved people be supported for life, and that freed children be bound to service until age 25 (not 26/24). #george-washington #slavery-history

Martha Washington freed her husband's 123 enslaved people about a year after his death (1 January 1801), rather than waiting for her own death in 1802 as the will allowed; the Custis dower slaves were never freed by her and were inherited by Custis heirs. #george-washington #slavery-history
